scenario: AITA for letting my (33M) best friend (33F) stay overnight at my place after she had a fight with her husband? | Jess and I have been friends since we were in the first grade. We kinda grew apart after high school and went to different universities. Though we weren't close anymore, we still call each other occasionally and hanging out over the summer holidays.
